features: ⚠️ BEFORE YOU UPDATE — 1.11.0 has the same requirements as 1.10.0: PHP 8.4.1 or later, MySQL 5.7 or later or MariaDB 10.3 or later, and the zip, curl, bcmath, fileinfo, gd, intl, mbstring, openssl, dom and xml extensions (gd is what generates the PDFs). Since 1.10.0 the update from the panel offers a copy of the database before the migrations: the «Backup di sicurezza» (safety backup) switch is on by default, and turning it off needs a confirmation. At that point the new files are already in place: if the update stops with an error that repeats identically at every attempt, first put back the files of the previous version and only then restore the backup from the «Gestione backups» (backup management) page. The update from 1.10.0 is run by the 1.10.0 engine: stay on the page until it ends; if it stops with an error, update with the installer file, or try again from the updates page when «Scarica e Installa» (download and install) becomes active again, ten minutes after the launch. Before you start it is still worth downloading a full backup from «Impostazioni» (settings) → «Gestione backups».

⚠️ IT TOUCHES THE DATABASE: WHAT IT ADDS — The update from 1.10.0 applies 26 new migrations by itself. They create the tables for ownership transfers, for the breakdown detail written when a plan is generated, for the accrual periods of the budget items, for the links between documents and categories, and for the ATECO classification, which the update fills with 3,257 codes; they add columns to invoices (the accrual period and the invoice that a credit note corrects), suppliers, balances, instalment plans and document categories. In the existing data the new columns stay empty, except for the transfers listed in the next entry. The update also adds the «Importa dati» (import data) permission, which administrators receive automatically. Whoever updates by hand over SSH runs php artisan kondomanager:aggiorna instead of the migrations alone: with the migrations alone the «Importa dati» permission and the ATECO codes are missing, and running the command afterwards fixes it. Instalment amounts, journal entries and balances stay as they were.

⚠️ IT TOUCHES THE DATABASE: THE DATA IT MOVES AND REWRITES — (1) The category of every document moves into the links table, and the old column is removed: from this version a document in the archive can be in more than one category. (2) If they are not there under their name, the five initial document categories («Bilanci», «Verbali», «Avvisi», «Contratti», «Fatture» — budgets, minutes, notices, contracts, invoices) and the nineteen initial supplier categories are added (ten are new, and «Altro» (other) comes back where it was missing): an initial document category you had deleted or renamed comes back with its default name. The category named «Fatture» gets an internal key, by which the program finds it even if you rename it. (3) Suppliers that already have a withholding tax, a regime or the flat-rate scheme declared count as decided, with the date of the last change to their record. (4) The accrual period an invoice already carried in its data moves into the new columns. (5) An instalment plan on a management linked to a single financial year takes that year. (6) In the instalment reminders that owners see in the portal, the sentence that promised the automatic offsetting of the credit against the next instalments becomes «il credito resta a tuo favore. L'amministratore può usarlo per compensare una tua quota da pagare o restituirtelo.» (the credit stays in your favour; the administrator can use it to offset one of your amounts due or refund it), or «il credito è stato usato o restituito.» (the credit has been used or refunded); the reminders of a person who has, on the same instalment, amounts due and amounts in credit recalculate the paid and remaining figures. (7) Two columns of the instalment shares and one of the person–unit links, which the program never filled, are removed: if the latter has values, the migration stops instead of deleting them. (8) The check that rejects the same invoice (supplier, number and date) applies within a condominium and no longer across different condominiums, and the amount already paid on a budget item can also be recorded per person.

⚠️ AFTER THE UPDATE: APP_URL, TRUSTED PROXIES AND OPEN PAGES — The links in the «Password dimenticata?» (forgot password) e-mail and in the e-mail asking to verify the email address carry the address written in APP_URL in the .env file (in the Docker image, the APP_URL environment variable); if APP_URL is still the default value, they carry the address the request came from. Check that APP_URL is the address you open the application with, with https:// if the application runs on https. Email verification links sent before the update are no longer valid: on the «Verifica indirizzo email» (verify email address) page the «Reinvia email di verifica» (resend verification email) button sends a new one. For trusted proxies the recommended value is TRUSTED_PROXIES=PRIVATE_SUBNETS: where the update from the panel is active, the block with TRUSTED_PROXIES=* that the engine of an earlier version had added to the .env becomes PRIVATE_SUBNETS by itself; a line written by hand stays as it is: if it says *, the recommended value is PRIVATE_SUBNETS, which however does not cover a proxy with a public address: for that one you write the list of its addresses. After the update, reload the application pages you had open.

LOGIN AND PASSWORDS — New passwords have at least 10 characters; the ones already saved, even shorter ones, stay valid until they are changed. Login has a limit on attempts. Sensitive actions (the «Sicurezza 2FA» (2FA security) page and its commands, downloading a backup, the backup password, the mail settings, giving powers to an account) ask you to type the password again, if you have not done so in the last 15 minutes; for saves and commands they ask for it in a window over the page: what you typed stays there, and after the confirmation the save starts again by itself. Changing the password closes the sessions open on other devices. The owner of an account receives an e-mail when their password, their email or their two-factor authentication changes. First-access links sent before the update, to people who have not chosen a password yet, are no longer valid: «Reinvita» (re-invite), from the user list, sends a new one. An invitation lasts three days.

USERS, ROLES AND PERMISSIONS — Whoever is not an administrator grants only the «utente» (user) and «fornitore» (supplier) roles, and manages only the accounts that have only these roles and no additional permission they lack themselves; the others are managed by the administrator. The role pages and the «Ruolo predefinito nuovi utenti» (default role for new users) belong to the administrator only. Contacts and suppliers are viewed, created, edited and deleted with the four contact permissions, and the default collaborator deletes neither. Importing a condominium requires the «Importa dati» (import data) permission: a collaborator you had entrusted with imports gets it from their user record. The mail, external cron and email log pages open with «Gestisci impostazioni generali» (manage general settings). In the portal a fault report or a communication opens to the people it is addressed to when it is published and approved, notifications go only to those who can open it, and an owner downloads only the documents they see in their list. Above the user list there are three cards («Totale utenti», «Da verificare», «Sospesi» — total users, to be verified, suspended) and the «Verifica» (verification) filter.

OWNERSHIP TRANSFERS AND TENANCIES — From the unit's holders page, «Registra passaggio» (record transfer) records five types of transfer: «Vendita o donazione» (sale or gift), «Inizio locazione» (start of tenancy), «Fine locazione» (end of tenancy), «Usufrutto» (usufruct: creation or extinction) and «Successione» (inheritance). You choose one date: the period of whoever leaves closes the day before, the period of whoever enters opens, and the unit's history stays whole. On ordinary expenses the unit's share is split over the days of ownership; on extraordinary expenses the resolution decides. Before recording, the «Cosa cambierà» (what will change) panel says what happens. In a sale, draft instalments due from the day of the transfer pass to the buyer, without touching issued instalments or payments; for instalments already issued the transfer writes the adjustment, a pair of balance lines that the next plan of the management absorbs. In a sale and in a usufruct the «Le parti hanno regolato il conguaglio fra loro» (the parties settled the adjustment between themselves) box leaves it out, with a note; at the end of a tenancy, and in an inheritance with the arrears in the deceased's name, you choose between «Scrivi il conguaglio» (write the adjustment) and «Non scriverlo» (do not write it). Where a part does not move by itself, the panel states the amount to settle by hand, and the way is the Wallet. From the unit's history («Chi ha avuto questa unità» — who has had this unit) the last recorded transfer can be cancelled, with instalments untouched, with a note.

TENANT CHARGES STATEMENT AND INHERITANCES — For a unit that has or has had a tenant, the holders page prints the «prospetto degli oneri accessori» (tenant charges statement) as a PDF: for each tenant, the items the breakdown puts on them, split over the days of the tenancy, and who reimburses whom, also in histories with several transfers and when a co-tenant stays. It is calculated at every print: a statement already handed over stays as it was, one printed again has today's figures. An inheritance splits the deceased's part among the heirs by share and includes the legacy; a sale can reserve the usufruct to the seller. When an instalment plan still counts the share of a deceased person, generation stops and states the part that passes to each heir: the way to pass it is the Wallet, with the balances linked to the inheritance, and generation also continues with the tick box and a note.

INSTALMENT PLAN — With «Abilita regole di ricorrenza avanzate» (enable advanced recurrence rules) the first instalment is the date chosen in «Prima scadenza» (first due date), and the following ones are the dates of the rule after it. A plan accepted with «Procedi comunque» (proceed anyway) because a share had no recipient has three states, «Allineato» (aligned), «Quota aperta» (open share) and «Disallineato» (misaligned), and a box at the top of the page lists the unassigned shares grouped by cause, with the reason and what to do. A plan accepted this way before the update does not have this list and stays «Disallineato»: «Ricalcola» (recalculate), where the plan can be recalculated, rebuilds it with today's data. On a management used across several financial years the plan page, «Sposta spesa» (move expense) and the task links follow the plan's financial year. An approved plan locks, besides the amount, the parent chapter, the type, the table and the percentages of its items. A budget item's amount is written without a sign, and a plan with an expense item with a negative amount, left over from before, stops before writing, and the plan page flags it in a red box. On a management used across several financial years the program does not split the amount already paid on an item between the years: next year's plan on an item with an amount already paid stops when, together with the previous year's plan, it asks for more than the item's amount, and the message says so.

BREAKDOWN AND PRINTS — At generation the plan writes the breakdown detail, item by item and person by person, and the two breakdown prints read it instead of recalculating it: the document says «Riparto registrato alla generazione del …» (breakdown recorded at generation on …), or «Riparto ricostruito dai dati attuali, non registrato» (breakdown rebuilt from current data, not recorded) for plans generated before the update. Balances of closed managements have the «Saldi precedenti» (previous balances) column, the amount already paid has its own, and «Addebito diretto» (direct charge) contains only expenses of a single unit. The breakdown by table always comes out on landscape A4, divided into blocks. An expense of a single unit that has nobody to go to (no owner, bare owner or usufructuary) stops generation, like any other shortfall, and asks for the reason.

XML AND P7M ELECTRONIC INVOICES — A purchase invoice is recorded by uploading the XML file or the signed .p7m envelope received from the SdI, many at once if you like: number, dates, amounts, lines, IBAN and supplier fill in by themselves, and a supplier that is not there is created from the file without leaving the page. The pension fund contribution enters the invoice as an expense line, and a file addressed to another condominium does not enter. While you fill in the form, the program warns if the invoice seems already recorded, without blocking; the same invoice (supplier, number and date) in the same condominium is rejected with a message. An invoice can have several attachments, uploaded from the invoice detail page without touching the journal. ⚠️ For a supplier on whom nobody ever took a position on withholding tax, recording the invoice asks once whether it is subject to withholding, with an answer proposed from the document; the answer, even «no», stays on the supplier's record.

CREDIT NOTES AND REVERSALS — A supplier's credit note is linked to the invoice it corrects: the form has the «Fattura che la nota rettifica» (invoice the note corrects) field, from the XML the program proposes it when it finds a single invoice, and notes already recorded are linked with «Collega a una fattura» (link to an invoice). From then on the invoice counts net of the note in the instalment plan cart, in the creation and recalculation of the plan and in the dashboard. Reversal, editing and deletion of an invoice that is in an instalment plan follow a single rule: as long as the plan has collected nothing, the invoice is first removed from the plan, and the message says how. A prior-year invoice with a part not covered by the opening balances asks for the period in which the cost accrued. An invoice with an expense charged to a single unit that an issued instalment has already requested cannot be reversed, and the refusal states the way.

WITHHOLDING TAX AND F24 — The «Ritenute e F24» (withholding tax and F24) schedule collects the withholdings to pay and the payment slips of all the condominium's financial years: once the old year is closed, December's withholdings, due by 16 January, stay in view. The 4% withholding on contracts goes on tax code 1020 when the payee is subject to IRES, non-commercial bodies included, and on 1019 otherwise: draft slips are redone with «Aggiorna scadenze» (update due dates), confirmed and unpaid ones are cancelled and redone, paid ones stay as they were. The two commission regimes are named «Provvigioni — base 50%, 11,5%» and «Provvigioni — base ridotta al 20% con la dichiarazione del percipiente, 4,6%» (commissions: 50% base, 11.5%; base reduced to 20% with the payee's declaration, 4.6%): the previous labels stated the reduction the wrong way round, so open the record of your commission suppliers and check the regime. The pension contribution a supplier pays to their own fund is not a withholding of the condominium, and the program keeps it separate.

PAYMENTS AND CREDITS — In a new payment receipt the «Versato da» (paid by) field records who actually made the transfer, when it is another person of the condominium: the debt stays with the debtor, and whoever paid stays on record. The credit of a management covers by itself only the instalments of its own management; when it could cover an instalment of another one, the form asks «Il credito passa di gestione?» (does the credit move to another management?). From the account statement of someone with an available credit the refund is recorded, and an instalment made only of credits goes into the journal. A person's account statement counts only the lines of their position as owner, with the accrual date. In the portal, an instalment reminder does not ask for what the person's credit covers. ⚠️ On the payments page the «Crediti da riallineare» (credits to realign) card appears if versions up to 1.10 left credits written on the wrong account or outside the issue of their instalment: «Scrivi le correzioni» (write the corrections) states how many entries it adds and writes them after your confirmation, without changing the existing ones. The same card lists, with the amount and without correcting them, instalments issued before this version with an expense charged to a single unit, which counted the advance on that expense twice in the journal; the owners' instalments were right.

INCOME ITEMS — Totals subtract income from expenses: with «Spese generali» (general expenses) at € 1,200.00 and the income item «Affitto antenna» (antenna rent) at € 240.00, the chart of accounts, the PDF slip and the instalment plan page say € 960.00 to allocate, like the instalments. The budget item of an invoice and that of an immediate settlement are expense items only, and «Sposta spesa» (move expense) works only between items of the same type. An immediate settlement recorded on an income item wrote a cash outflow: on the «Fatture passive» (purchase invoices) page a box lists them, with «Apri» (open), which leads to the entry with the «Storna» (reverse) button.

CASH BOOK, LEDGER ACCOUNTS, BALANCE SHEET AND TREASURY — In the Movimenti (transactions) bar there is «Prima nota» (cash book), the register of cash movements in chronological order, with the movement date and the recording date, the running balance and the print. «Stato patrimoniale» (balance sheet) is a page: the position item by item, the year's financial summary and six named checks («Partita doppia», «Quadratura patrimoniale», «Raccordo fra cassa e competenza», «Vincoli e casse fondo», «Liquidità e riepilogo», «Casse reali sotto zero» — double entry, balance sheet reconciliation, cash-to-accrual reconciliation, restrictions and fund accounts, liquidity and summary, real cash accounts below zero), each with its remedy; the comparison with the bank statement remains a check for the administrator. Each account's ledger starts from the carried-forward balance, opens the counter-entry of each line and can be printed, and its «Stampa» (print) menu produces the general ledger of all accounts. The «Libro Giornale» (journal) reads line by line and can be printed. In the condominium dashboard the actions suggested by the «Tesoreria a 30gg» (30-day treasury) box open their page: the instalment receipts, the instalment plans of the open financial year (or the list of financial years, if none is open) and the invoices.

IMPORT FROM ANOTHER MANAGEMENT PROGRAM — From Danea Domustudio you can also upload the «Import/Export tramite Excel» lists: when no file states the condominium, the screen asks which one to import into, and Danea's extraordinary financial years become managements. From the final balance the expense chapters come in with their items, with zero amounts. Whoever has no usable export downloads the Excel template from the import screen («Compilo a mano» — I fill it in by hand): a cover sheet and four lists (units, people, millesimal tables, opening balances). A sheet left blank does not stop the others. An import that created the condominium can be undone with a confirmation, as long as nobody has worked on it; when it cannot, the screen says what prevents it. An import left halfway by a colleague is not visible to the others.

SUPPLIERS, CONTACTS AND DOCUMENTS — Next to the «Codice ATECO» (ATECO code) field of the supplier record there is a search over ISTAT's ATECO 2025 classification, by code or by words; the field can still be typed by hand. Supplier categories are created, renamed and deleted from «Gestisci le categorie» (manage categories), in the supplier list, and the «+» next to the drop-down in the record creates one on the spot; the supplier list has the category column and filter. The municipality is searched instead of typed. In the «Rubrica» (contacts), a person's name opens their record. A document in the archive is in one or more categories, also when an owner uploads it from the portal; the «Fatture» (invoices) category is found even if you rename it. A category that has documents cannot be deleted, and the window says which ones.

INSTALLATION, DOCKER AND RESTORE — On a server the manual installation is done with the kondomanager:installa command, which creates the administrator with the installer's data, and the example configuration file is for production, with debug off: whoever installed by hand should check APP_ENV=production and APP_DEBUG=false in the .env, and change the password of admin@km.com if it is still the one in the README. After a git pull the kondomanager:aggiorna command runs the migrations and aligns roles and permissions, the list of municipalities, the ATECO classification and the recorded version. There is a production Docker image, ghcr.io/vince844/kondomanager-core: at every start it installs if the database is empty and aligns it if it already exists. The development Docker (docker compose), after a git pull, is rebuilt with --build, and at every start it too aligns roles and permissions, municipalities, ATECO and version. Uploaded documents can live on S3 storage, with DOCUMENTI_DISK=s3. Restoring a backup resumes from where it stopped, can be resumed with the password, and stops before touching the database if the safety backup fails.

SECURITY — This version fixes vulnerabilities in earlier versions and updates the libraries: it is worth updating if your installation can be reached from the internet. The details are published in the repository's security advisories. Pages without login, the login page included, do not state the installed version; the application pages do not open inside a frame of another site and, with https, the browser remembers for 30 days to use https only. A vulnerability is reported privately, from the repository's Security tab, and not in an issue.
